exchangeInstruction: Click the cards you want to exchange, then press Exchange or Stand.
madePatLowBanner: ✨ Made an 8-or-better low — stand pat recommended

tutorial.playerHand: Your 5 cards. Aim for the lowest hand with no straight or flush (the Ace is always high).
tutorial.exchangeButton: Click cards to discard and press Exchange. Up to three draws per hand.
tutorial.betControls: Pick a betting action: call, raise, fold, and so on.
tutorial.resultMessage: The result appears here. 7-5-4-3-2 (a seven-low) is the strongest hand.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset to start a new hand.

hint.standPat: You hold an 8-or-better low — stand pat.
hint.dropDup: Discard pairs and high cards to draw to a low.
hint.callWithValue: A decent low is worth a value call.
hint.checkWeak: Weak hand, but no outstanding bet — check.
